objective: Repriorizar y completar el diagnostico de solo lectura del esquema real ManagementPro de 130QRO para aislar el rc=2 de pagos ISCAM. No modificar datos ni Produccion.

queries.name: mpro_payment_schema
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS tabla, c.column_id, c.name AS columna, ty.name AS tipo, c.max_length FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Venta_Encabezado','Comanda_Pago','Forma_Pago','Comanda') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: mpro_sales_august_by_branch
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (20) CONVERT(varchar(40),Sc_Cve_Sucursal) AS sucursal, COUNT(*) AS ventas, MIN(CONVERT(date,Vn_Fecha)) AS fecha_min, MAX(CONVERT(date,Vn_Fecha)) AS fecha_max FROM Venta_Encabezado WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CONVERT(date,Vn_Fecha) >= CONVERT(date,'2026-08-01') AND CONVERT(date,Vn_Fecha) < CONVERT(date,'2026-09-01') GROUP BY Sc_Cve_Sucursal ORDER BY ventas DESC

queries.name: mpro_payment_tables_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT 'Venta_Encabezado' AS tabla, COUNT(*) AS filas FROM Venta_Encabezado WITH (NOLOCK) UNION ALL SELECT 'Comanda_Pago', COUNT(*) FROM Comanda_Pago WITH (NOLOCK) UNION ALL SELECT 'Forma_Pago', COUNT(*) FROM Forma_Pago WITH (NOLOCK) UNION ALL SELECT 'Comanda', COUNT(*) FROM Comanda WITH (NOLOCK)
